detail.longDescription: A photo fills your phone screen but prints as a tiny rectangle or runs into the edge. The photo and the paper have different proportions. The guide covers choosing A4 (210 × 297 mm) or US Letter (8.5 × 11 in) by what the recipient uses, placing images without stretching, checking readability at print size, and why printer scaling is a separate step from the PDF. https:// pixoate.com/blog/photos-a4-us- letter-pdf-printing # Printing # PDF # PrintTips # Productivity
